identityCautions: Apostle John differs from John the Baptist and John Mark. Epistle authorship does not prove exact face/date/setting. Do not assign a named face from clothing, headbands, anonymous disciple groups or the word children. Superseded Pentecost/first-journey v1, sending-twelve v1 and arrest v1 are not reactivated. Historical 1 John candidate inventory is not an approved-anchor list. Noah ark scenes permit eight adults without children aboard.
futureGenerationRequirement: For every generation/edit with an identifiable recurring person, supply actual clear approved earlier identity image files as visual inputs; descriptions or prior viewing alone are insufficient. Genesis 7 is style only. Compare full size with actual references and nearby cross-book depictions; elapsed narrative time controls aging. Reject unresolved identity drift or use a text-faithful nonportrait scene.
